title: PM Modi's address to the Nation | 30th June 2020 | PMO
description: Prime Minister Narendra Modi's address to the Nation  on 30th June 2020   #PMModiLive #IndiaFightsCorona --------------------------------------------------------------------------- ►Subscribe https://goo.gl/C3hVED | to Prime Minister Office’s official Youtube channel.  Get the latest updates :bell: from PM’s Office: news, speeches, public outreach, national events, official state visits, PM’s foreign visits, and much more...  You can also connect with us on the official PMO website & other Social Media channels – ►Website – http://www.pmindia.gov.in ►Facebook – https://www.facebook.com/PMOIndia ►Twitter – https://twitter.com/PMOIndia ►Instagram – https://www.instagram.com/pmoindia

asr.full_text: Where cold, cough, fever, all these things happen, these cases increase, I pray to all my countrymen to be careful at this time. Friends, it is true that if you look at the death rate from Corona, India is in a state of turmoil in many countries of the world. We have to pay close attention to these areas. We have to stop them. We have to stop them. We have to explain them. You have seen in the news. You have seen in the news. The Prime Minister of a country. You have seen a fine of Rs. 13,000. So it happened. Because he did not even wear a mask. Even in India. So, as soon as the lockdown was in place, the government provided the Minister with the Garib Kalyane Yojana. The scheme was given a package of Rs. 2 lakh crore for the poor. Friends, in the last three months, Rs. 20 crore has been put into the Jandan accounts of the poor families. Rs. 31,000 crore has been deposited directly. During this period, over Rs. 9 crore has been deposited in the bank accounts of farmers. Rs. 18,000 crore has been deposited. In addition, to provide employment to the rural population. The government has given food to more than two times the population of Brittany and the population of the European Union. Friends, I am going to do a very important gathering today. Friends, during the rainy season. And then mainly. In the agricultural sector, there is more work. In other sectors, there is a little sluggishness. The scheme to provide free grain to 80 crore people will now be in force in July, August, September, October, November. For these five months, the government will extend the scheme to more than 80 crore poor brothers and sisters. Every month, every member of the family will be given free grain or rice. Also, every family will be given free grain of one kg every month. Friends, today the government is able to give free grain to the poor if they need it. So the third part of it goes to two main sections. Firstly, our country's great farmers are our food-seekers. And secondly, the honest taxpayers of our country are your constant dedication to the work that the country is doing. You have filled the country's grain reserves. So today the crop of the country is burning. We will continue to advance economic activities as we all step up. We will work day and night for India all over the temple. We will be the voices for the locals. With this resolution. We will work together with 130 crore countrymen. With this resolution. We must work together. We must move forward. Once again. I pray to you all. I pray for you also. I beg you all to stay affordable. Keep the distance of the gaze. And for this, many important decisions were taken by our government. And then again, it has come to the conclusion that Pradhan Mantri Garib Kalyan Yojana has been extended.

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is non-scam content because it presents a public address about coronavirus precautions and government relief measures, including a stated free-grain program for poor households. The subscription request is ordinary channel engagement and is not explicitly linked to payment, investment, credentials, or participation in the relief program. The available frames do not independently establish every detail of the spoken or displayed policy claims.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: A national address about public precautions and government food relief is general public-affairs content.
